A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have produced a catalog of positions and proper motions of over 105 million stars with a median magnitude of R = 16 and a positional accuracy of 15 to 20 mas per coordinate.
the UCAC4 star positions are about 10 times better than the Hipparcos positions and the UCAC4 proper motions are about 10 to 100 times better than those of Hipparcos.
the UCAC4 catalog is a significant improvement over the earlier versions, UCAC2 and UCAC3, in both positional and photometric accuracy, as well as completeness.

the UCAC4 proper motions are more precise than those of UCAC3.
